Director367: for the horse rearing, the reference video lays out the acceptance criteria. 100% from a motion perspective, and substantially from an appearance perspective since both of them are so linked if we are going to bring this to life.
Go ahead. Once you implement the process changes I am approving10 motion cycles, let us get motion right first for the horse.
rationale: Mixed request reconciled: implement proposed smaller-unit/reference-gate process first, then continue original motion task with ten approved cycles and reference-faithful horse preparation through firstlift. No appearance polish/new model/provider/spend/cloud/upload.
